title: Xiao Yan Comes Back
summary: Xiao Yan's Black-Corner allies, a crowd of Dou Wangs, join the fight at the Mite'er Manor and he orders that no attacker be spared. He meets Ya Fei, his eldest brother Xiao Ding, whose legs were paralysed by poison, and Xiao Li, now a Dou Wang. Jia Xing Tian sends Yao Ye with imperial troops to arrest the Misty Cloud disciples. Xiao Yan and Hai Bodong kill Yun Du and Yun Cha, and Elder Yun Fu and seven other elders die. On Misty Cloud Mountain, Yun Shan learns from the broken soul tokens that Xiao Yan has returned and puts the mountain on alert. The Hall of Souls envoy tells him to capture Xiao Yan alive and leave Yao Chen's soul to him. After the battle, Xiao Yan gives Hai Bodong the Spiritual Recovery Purple Pill and plans to rally the capital's powers against the Misty Cloud Sect.
events: Jia Xing Tian decides to back Xiao Yan and sends troops
Xiao Yan's Dou Wang allies attack the Misty Cloud force
Xiao Yan reunites with Ya Fei, Xiao Ding and Xiao Li
Yao Ye arrives and the imperial army arrests the attackers
Xiao Yan and Hai Bodong kill Yun Du and Yun Cha
Yun Shan learns of Xiao Yan's return and seals off Misty Cloud Mountain
The Hall of Souls envoy demands Xiao Yan alive
Xiao Yan gives Hai Bodong the Spiritual Recovery Purple Pill
cultivation: Xiao Li became a Dou Wang within two years. Yun Shan judges Xiao Yan to be at least a Dou Huang from his aura.
